title: Lifetime Tracer
description:
A class that logs every special member call, used to run experiments.
```
[#1] default ctor
[#2] copy ctor from #1
[#3] move ctor from #2
[#3] destructor
...
```
hints: The move constructor takes `Tracer&& other` and is called when the source is a temporary or wrapped in `std::move`. Mark it `noexcept`; then watch what a growing vector does with and without it (lesson 7.05).
requirements: `class Tracer` with a unique id (a static counter) that prints a line in each of the six special members: default constructor, copy and move constructor, copy and move assignment, destructor

Experiments, each with your **prediction written as a comment first**: pass by value, by `const&` and by `&&`; return by value; `push_back` vs `emplace_back`; a vector growing with and without `reserve`
A short note after each experiment saying whether your prediction was right
